name.value: Mulvehill Creek Wilderness Inn and Wedding Chapel

description.value: Mulvehill Creek Wilderness Inn is a small inn situated on Highway 23 South outside Revelstoke, a route that carries touring cyclists toward the Shelter Bay ferry and the Columbia River valley. Its name references the creek and wilderness setting along Upper Arrow Lake. It is the kind of remote roadside accommodation that touring cyclists on multi-day routes through the Selkirks would rely on.
